simple.summary: גַּבַּי (Gabbay) means Gabbai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Neh 11 8.

definitions.full: H1373. Gabbay סַלָּ֑י גַּבַּי apparently proper name, masculine (compare Aramaic , Talmud גַּבָּי , tax-gatherer ) a Benjamite Neh 11:8 ; but text dubious compare 1Chr 9:8 & Sm Listen 7 .
